Before I download all the available data, I'm going to test it on the control samples from GSE247228.

The sra Run numbers are as follows:
    - SRR26705626
    - SRR26705627
    - SRR26705629

## Get FASTQ Files

I'll be using SRA-Toolkit/2.10.8 for this. Specifically, the `fasterq-dump` function.

```{bash get-computing-power}
srun_l -c 12 -p himem --x11 --pty bash
```

```{bash get-fastqs}
ml SRA-Toolkit/2.10.8
fasterq-dump -O input/fastqs SRR26705626 SRR26705627 SRR26705629
```
